compat.text: It contains ultraviolet light stabilisers according to EN 13956 / GB 12952. Sarnafil® G 410-20 L Felt is a hot-air weldable roof membrane, formulated for direct exposure and designed for use in all global climatic conditions.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: The use of Sarnafil® G 410-20 L Felt membrane is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of - 50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to + 50°C.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Not compatible in direct contact with bitumen, tar, fat, oil, solvent containing materials and other plastic materials, e.g. expanded polystyrene (EPS), extruded polystyrene (XPS), polyurethane (PUR), polyisocyanurate (PIR) or phenolic foam (PF). These materials could adversely affect the product properties.
